name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-email-to-planner-task
title: Email to Planner Task
shortDescription: Converts flagged Outlook emails into Planner tasks with subject as title, sender/body context as notes, a 2-business-day due date, and a Teams confirmation notification.
longDescription: Monitors an Outlook mailbox for flagged/starred emails and automatically creates a Planner task: subject as title, sender name + received date + first 500 chars of body as notes, due date calculated as 2 business days after receipt, assigned to the mailbox owner. Sends a Teams notification with a direct Planner task link. Solves the universal inbox-to-action pain point with zero behavior change required from the user.

metadata.value: Build a workflow that converts flagged Outlook emails into Planner tasks with auto-calculated due date and Teams confirmation.
